summary: Path loss exceeds threshold (0.69% + 0.68% vs 0.1% threshold): 0.69% lost on link between LEAF-07 Gi1/0/48 SPAN destination and VF-1 1/1, plus 0.68% discarded at IDS eth1 capture interface. Link error counters healthy.

findings.root_cause: Physical transport loss between LEAF-07 Gi1/0/48 (SPAN destination, sent 4,327,500 packets) and VF-1 port 1/1 (received 4,297,740 packets) - 29,760 packets (0.69%) lost on cable/optic or via an unmonitored inline device between them.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS misses ~0.69% of traffic before packet broker, creating blind spot; IDS cannot detect attacks in lost packets and flow records will be incomplete.

recommended_fix.why: Clean/replace fiber/cable and optics, check interface error counters (FCS, drops) on both ends, and verify no unmonitored device is bridging this link.

findings.root_cause: IDS eth1 capture interface discarded 29,340 packets (0.68% of received) because the tool's capture path could not keep up with offered rate.
findings.impact_on_tool: Even correctly forwarded traffic is dropped at IDS NIC before analysis; IDS with needs_full_payload and needs_both_directions will have incomplete sessions and missed detections.

recommended_fix.why: IDS is overrun at 1G: tune capture (increase ring buffers, enable AF_PACKET/DPDK, pin CPUs), or reduce load via packet broker filtering/load_balance, or upgrade tool capacity.
